headline: Government, in plain English.
lede: Bills, budgets and legislative records are written for lawyers. These tools turn them into something anyone can read in a few minutes, with the original source one click away.

before.text: If a provider elects to transmit emergency alerts to subscribers by satellite under paragraph (1), the provider may not impose a separate or additional charge for such transmission or capability.

after: If your phone company sends emergency alerts by satellite, it can't charge you more for them.
